Varicose veins are large, blue, raised, swollen, twisted blood vessels. They often develop on the legs and feet.

Asclera (Polidocanol) is a solution that is injected that irritates the walls of the veins, causing it to collapse. Overtime, the body harmlessly metabolizes the blood vessel.
